title: WAMTA important dates list (important_dates.yml)
description: Drives the Important Dates sidebar card rendered by _includes/card-important-dates.html. Each entry is {date, text} with optional timezone. The strikethrough/'past' state is derived at render time by comparing 'date' to site.time; it is not encoded in the data.

date.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD date or the literal string TBA.

text.description: Deadline description (e.g. 'Deadline for proceedings paper submission').

timezone.description: Optional timezone qualifier (e.g. 'AoE'). For year-wide suffixes, prefer config.important_dates_card_suffix.
